text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series has begun for Yaeno Muteki, a runner trained in the Kongo Yaegaki style of martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When she was a child, she was an incorrigible handful who would fly into rages and strong-arm others into doing what she wanted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her grandfather taught her in the Kongo Yaegaki style to help her control her emotions—and suppress the "blaze fierce" of her anger with "water still."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She aims to put this philosophy to good use and seeks glory in the world of racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all, her grandparents helped her so much, and she wants to show them how much she's grown. Intent on repaying them, Yaeno Muteki begins her battle!
